title: Inverse-CDF sampling, continuous and discrete
alt: Left, the curve y² with height 1/4 mapping to y = 1/2. Right, a staircase CDF where the band of heights from 0.30 to 0.50 maps entirely to face 4.
caption: Pick a height, read across to the CDF. A steep stretch concentrates outcomes; a jump claims a whole band of heights.
data_source: Exact curves: F(y)=y^2 on [0,1], and the staircase CDF of the loaded die with probabilities (0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.20, 0.30) from the post.
